name: com.netmon/netmon
title: Netmon
description: Query devices, alerts, syslog, NetFlow and metrics on your Netmon monitoring appliance.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.notes: Local stdio bridge shipped as an MCPB bundle. The bridge forwards JSON-RPC to the Streamable HTTP /mcp endpoint on the operator's own Netmon appliance; there is no vendor-hosted endpoint, so no `remotes` entry is published.
